text: Could you make a cartoon of a little orange robot watering a potted plant? I have a soft spot for little robots doing ordinary things, which is why this idea appeals to me. For the video itself, I want it to be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Please put 'Small steps' at the top throughout, and have no sound. I'm probably over-explaining because I've been picturing this little scene for a while.
